remarks: Beautifully maintained 2nd Floor Apartment in Prime Location near Stew Leonard's and convenient to shopping, dining and commuting routes! Private, main level entry foyer w/hardwood floors and access to shared basement. Upstairs is an open concept living room, eat-in kitchen with pantry, and spacious bedroom all with hardwood floor. Plenty of closets and full walk-up attic for storage. Full bath with stackable washer & dryer. Use of 1 Bay of 2 Car Garage and other off-street parking. Qualifications include verifiable Income greater than $80K. Excellent Credit History and a FICO Score greater than 700 is a MUST. Please inquire as to process for rental application and current credit report. Income verification includes paystubs W-2's and Tax Returns. No Pets/No Smoking/ No Exceptions. Owner/Agent.
